metadata.title: Cinematic Field Portrait with Dual-Era Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-full shot of a man in a dark overcoat standing in a vast, flat grassy field under a moody, overcast sky. The composition is framed by formal serif text at the top and a fluid, white script at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a low horizon line
Contrast between the structured top serif and the organic bottom script
Muted, earthy tones of the field against the desaturated blue of the sky
The subject's dark clothing anchoring the center of the frame
coreInvariants: Low horizon line at approximately the lower third
Horizontal rule lines flanking the top text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, medium-full scale from head to mid-thigh.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark mass of the overcoat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top serif text, moves down to the subject's face, and rests on the script at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and field provide significant breathing room around the subject.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange/red (top text) and stark white (bottom text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic Roman Serif and Formal Script
letterConstructionRules: Top text: All-caps, high-contrast serifs with elongated vertical stems on initials
Bottom text: Slanted, connected cursive with medium weight and rounded terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters in the top line are significantly larger (dropped or raised) than the rest of the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, historical serif with a personal, handwritten script.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rules extending from the top text to the edges

preserve: The color contrast between top and bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif structure of the top text.
Captures the fluid, 80s-style cursive energy of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic photograph of a man with 80s-style voluminous hair wearing a long grey overcoat, standing in the center of a flat, green soccer field at twilight. The sky is a moody, overcast blue-grey. Low horizon line. Film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a line of burnt-orange serif text at the top, flanked by thin white horizontal lines. Add a line of white cursive script at the bottom, centered and slightly overlapping the grass.

verificationChecks: Are the horizontal rules present at the top?
Is the bottom text a fluid script?
Is the color palette muted and earthy?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the top text (red vs orange)
The exact height of the horizon line
mustRedesign: The specific facial features of the subject
Any specific brand logos on the clothing
The exact wording of the text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the top text is all-caps serif
Ensure the bottom text is title-case script
Check that the horizon line is straight and low
Verify the subject is in a medium-full shot
Confirm the presence of horizontal rules at the top
recipe.reuseFormula: Central portrait + Low horizon field + Top serif with rules + Bottom script overlay
